request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Recolour only the skin of his arms, shoulders, hands, legs and feet: from pale cream to a light sage green, colour #8fb571, with #739a59 as shading. His face, chest and round belly stay pale cream-green. The orange paint splashes become bright hazard yellow, colour #fdd20f. Keep everything else exactly the same: the mossy hair and beard, tusks, stone club, straps, belt, loincloth, wrist bands, pose, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
